posts.meta_description:
398K likes, 832 comments - rubinadilaik on October 4, 2026: "There are people you meet professionally, and then there are people who leave a mark on you personally. Rohit Shetty sir, you have been that person for me. ❤️

You’ve been so much more than the host of Khatron Ke Khiladi. You’ve been a mentor, a constant source of encouragement, and someone whose words and belief have genuinely made a difference to me.

What makes you so special is the warmth and personal effort you bring into every interaction. You have this incredible ability to make people feel seen, supported and capable of more than they believe they can do. And I’ve personally experienced that.

If I’m being completely honest, you were one of the biggest reasons I came back for another season. Your encouragement, your guidance and the faith you showed in me made me want to take that leap again.

I’ll always be deeply grateful for everything you’ve done—not just for the show, but for me personally. Khatron Ke Khiladi wouldn’t be what it is without the heart, energy and leadership you bring to it.

To one of the finest hosts Indian television has ever seen, but more importantly, to a wonderful mentor and an even more wonderful human being—thank you, sir. ❤️

Here’s to you, and to the impact you may not even realise you’ve had on people like me. 🙏❤️ @itsrohitshetty".

197K likes, 893 comments - rubinadilaik on October 3, 2026: "There are moments when you realise that every late night, every ounce of energy, every doubt and every little detail was leading to this one moment.

When people from different worlds come together with one shared vision and create something that touches people and succeeds… it truly feels like a little miracle.

So grateful for the people, the journey, and everything we poured into making this happen. ✨❤️ The journey of Khatron Ke Khiladi ends, but the friendship will continue to grow 😇🙏🏻".

179K likes, 1,065 comments - rubinadilaik on October 1, 2026: "To every woman who feels she lost a little of herself while becoming a mother — this is for you. 🤍

Motherhood changes us, but it doesn’t erase the woman we were. Her dreams, her strength, her identity — they’re still there, waiting to be rediscovered.

Celebrate the mother you’ve become, but never forget to celebrate the woman within her.

To every mother finding her way back to herself — you are strong, you are resilient, and you are worthy of celebrating too. ✨ #kk 15 🙏🏻".

posts.meta_description:
50K likes, 335 comments - rubinadilaik on October 1, 2026: "Almost seven nights here, and we left with something much more than memories of a beautiful stay. We left feeling genuinely cared for. 🤍

There was such a quiet warmth in this place — in the kindness of the people, the graciousness of the staff, and in the way the owner personally made sure that we were comfortable at every step.

What touched us most was how thoughtfully they made our family feel special. Abhinav’s birthday was celebrated with so much love, and a cultural program was beautifully arranged just for us and our family. These weren’t just arrangements; they were gestures that made us feel truly welcomed.

The food was simple, warm and home-like — the kind that makes you sit a little longer around the table. Our family felt safe, relaxed and completely at home here, and we enjoyed every single moment.

To everyone who looked after us, thank you. Truly. For your warmth, your kindness, your patience, and for making six nights feel like we were staying with people who genuinely cared about us.

We came as guests, but we left with a lot of gratitude in our hearts. ❤️ @the_gawaling_ladakh".
